versions.changelog:
Initial release of revertwtf-mcp-server skill.

- Exposes a read-only MCP server for bounded catalog search, parser, selector lookup, AA explanations, x402 entries, and Blockscout registry tools.
- Provides tools such as explain_error, decode_revert_data, search_catalog, get_error, and more for agent integration.
- Enforces JSON outputs and paginated/bounded search for efficient and compatible data access.
- Focuses on easy and precise retrieval of error and catalog information for agents encountering EVM/AA/revert issues.
- Includes clear operating and testing guidelines to ensure reliability and clean test runs.
